description: This source file contains the implementation of the InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache class within the Orleans framework. It maintains a cache mapping grain interface methods to their implementation methods, including support for generic methods, and provides methods to retrieve these mappings based on types. It is used to facilitate efficient method invocation routing in Orleans grains.

classes.name: InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache
classes.description: A cache class that maps grain interface methods to their implementation methods, supporting retrieval and handling of generic methods.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: A struct representing a mapping entry between an interface method and an implementation method, with support for generic method instantiation.

methods.name: GetOrCreate
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a mapping from interface methods to implementation methods for given implementation and interface types.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceToImplementationMap
methods.description: Creates a dictionary mapping each interface's methods to their implementation methods for a given implementation type.
